l-e-h1-b01-15.goal: Wara na tene mbeni règle na aexemples mingi ti tongana nyen a sara kua na passé progressif na passé simple, na kaï règle na mbeni fini cas.
l-e-h1-b01-15.material: I was cooking when the phone rang. / While we were eating, the lights went out. / I cooked when the phone rang. (sens so mbi akamata ti sara cuisine pekoni ti so téléphone asara son)
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.prompt: Règle nyen alingbi na aphrases ota?
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.a: Sara kua na passé progressif ti ye so ayeke na yâ ti ti sara, na passé simple ti ye so asï na milieu
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.b: Sara kua na passé progressif ti ye so asï na milieu, na passé simple ti fond
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.b: Rang na went out ayeke aye so asï na milieu, na ala ayeke na passé simple.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.c: Sara kua gï na passé progressif ti aévénements use
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: Chaque phrase asara kua nga na passé simple (rang, went out).
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.d: Sens ayeke même na ngoi kue même tongana ngoi achange
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.d: Ota phrase atene tënë ti mbeni ye mbeni mbeni na ti kozo phrase.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.explain: Événement ti fond so ayeke na yâ ti ti sara a tene ni na passé progressif (was cooking), na ye so asï pekoni a tene ni na passé simple (rang).
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: Ye so ayeke na yâ ti ti sara, ti sara cuisine, ayeke was cooking, na téléphone so asara son na milieu ayeke rang, ni la fond ayeke passé progressif na ye so asï na milieu ayeke passé simple.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s2.model.1: I cooked asara sens so mbi asara cuisine pekoni ti so téléphone asara son, ni la mo lingbi ti bâ règle so sens achange na ngoi.

l-e-h1-b02-11.title: Règle ti expression ti nömörö + of which/whom
l-e-h1-b02-11.goal: Wara na tene règle na ndö ti cas mingi ti lege so a sara na of which na of whom, na pekoni bâ règle so na cas ti sika.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.a: of which a sara na ni ti azo, na of whom a sara na ni ti ye
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: of which a sara na ni ti ye (livre, voiture), na of whom a sara na ni ti azo (membre).
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.b: Pekoni ti expression ti nömörö, ni atene ti ndo oko ti kue so a tene kozo
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.c: Verbe na proposition relative ayeke ngbâ singulier
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: Verbe achanger na gbe tî quantité so aga kozo, tongana were, are, is.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: Of whom na of which a sara kua na ala na kozo mingi tî phrase
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: Anzo use kûê a sara kua na ala na mitan tî phrase.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Tongana two of which na most of whom, ala afa ndambo tî tout so a tene awe na kozo.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Ala afa ndambo tî tout, tongana livres 2 na yâ tî 5 na most of membres 20, ndali ni ayeke même règle.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Of which wala of whom na pekoni tî expression tî quantité afa nom so aga kozo, ndali ni ala atene ndambo.

l-e-h1-b02-12.title: Ye so aga na pekoni tî although na despite
l-e-h1-b02-12.goal: Gi na tene règle na yâ tî cas mingi tî forme so aga na pekoni tî although na despite, na pekoni vérifier règle so na cas nouveau.
l-e-h1-b02-12.material: Correct: Although it was cold, we swam. / Despite the cold, we swam. Incorrect: Despite it was cold, we swam. / Although the cold, we swam.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: Règle wa alingbi na phrases tî exemple?
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.a: Clause aga na pekoni tî although na despite use
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.a: Despite it was cold ayeke ôko tî phrases tî exemple so ayeke faux.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.b: Clause aga na pekoni tî although, na groupe nominal aga na pekoni tî despite
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.c: Although aga gï na mitan tî phrase
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: Na phrase tî exemple so ayeke correct, a sara kua na although na kozo mingi tî phrase.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: Despite ayeke na sens contraire tî although
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Anzo use kûê afa même ye, ‘in spite of’.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Although amû sujet + verbe, na despite amû nom (groupe). Sens ayeke même.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Gï phrases tî exemple so Although it was cold ayeke clause na Despite the cold ayeke groupe nominal ayeke correct, ndali ni ayeke règle.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: Phrases tî exemple so ayeke faux ayeke faux ndali ala azia clause na pekoni tî despite na groupe nominal na pekoni tî although, ndali ni mo lingbi tî bâ règle.

l-e-h1-b07-03.title: Wara règle ti whether na if
l-e-h1-b07-03.goal: Wara na tene règle ti amples exemples ti whether na if so akamata aclauses nominales, na kaï règle so na mbeni fini cas.
l-e-h1-b07-03.material: ○ I wonder if the shop is open. ○ I wonder whether the shop is open. ○ Whether the shop is open is unclear. × If the shop is open is unclear. Wara règle na zia ye na ndo vide.

l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.explain: Gï whether a sara kua na ni ti clause nominale na place ti sujet. if alingbi ti aga gï na place ti objet ti verbe tongana wonder.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: Na aexemples, gï Whether ayeke ○ na If ayeke × na place ti sujet, ni la sara kua na Whether na ndo vide nga.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: if aga gï na place ti objet pekoni ti wonder, ni la phrase so, so ndo vide ayeke place ti sujet, ayeke ye ti Whether.

l-e-h1-b04-05.title: Ti sa choix forme progressive: ndo nyen ni akpe?
l-e-h1-b04-05.goal: Kua na aétapes ti kua ti I was reading when the lights went out, wala chaîne ti cause na résultat, ti wara na sara lisoro ndo so ni akpe kozo.
l-e-h1-b04-05.material: Phrase: I was reading when the lights went out. Mbeni kua so afa ti sa choix ti ngoi. ① Ti lire angbâ tongana lumières asï ② Ti si ti lumières ayeke mbeni ye ti ngoi kete ③ Mbeni action so angbâ ayeke passé simple, na mbeni ye ti ngoi kete ayeke passé progressif ④ Ni la I read when the lights were going out ayeke tâ
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.o.a: ① Ti lire angbâ tongana lumières asï
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.r.a: Ni alingbi na sens ti phrase. Étape so ayeke tâ.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.r.b: Ni alingbi na sens ti phrase. Étape so ayeke tâ.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.o.b: ② Ti si ti lumières ayeke mbeni ye ti ngoi kete
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.o.c: ③ Mbeni action so angbâ ayeke passé simple, mbeni ye ti ngoi kete ayeke passé progressif
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.r.d: Ni ayeke gï résultat so aga na ③, na kozo ndo so ni akpe ape.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.explain: Mbeni action so angbâ a sara kua na passé progressif (was reading), na mbeni ye ti ngoi kete so asï na milieu a sara kua na passé simple (went out). ③ ayeke ti kiri.

l-e-h1-b05-30.material: The firm will adopt a flexible scheduling policy so that employees can attend to personal matters. Sara écrire ni na amots so ayeke easy.
l-e-h1-b05-30.s.s1.prompt: Phrase easy nyen so ayeke na sens même?

l-e-h1-b05-30.s.s2.model.1: Ati ye so ayeke na yâ ti texte ape wala ayeke ndö na ndö, ni la phrase so atene flexible hours ayeke tâ.

l-e-h1-b05-38.material: After we ate lunch, we left. After + -ing: changer ye so aga na pekoni tî After na forme -ing tî bata même sens.

l-e-h1-b05-38.s.s2.model.1: Zo so adü ayeke même we, ndali ni mo lingbi tî sara kêtê ni na -ing actif.

l-e-h1-b06-06.s.s2.model.1: Forme objet ti zo ayeke "whom", ndali ni "to whom I spoke" ayeke nzoni.

l-e-h1-b01-34.material: Ni atene ti si e yeke sara picnic tongana temps ayeke nzoni. A: Weather permitting, we will hold the picnic. B: Weather permitted, we will hold the picnic.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.prompt: Fa phrase so ayeke nzoni ahon na ndani ti ni.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.o.a: A: Sujet ti participe ayeke oko na sujet ti clause ti kota
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.r.a: Na so asujet ayeke sio: weather na we.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.o.b: A: Weather ayeke so a mû permission na ndö ti ni, so la -ing

l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.r.c: Weather ayeke so a mû permission, so ayeke so a mû permission na ni pëpe.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.r.d: Sens ni changé na ndö ti temps na form.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.explain: weather ayeke so ‘a mû permission’, so la permitting ayeke nzoni. Participial phrase ayeke na sujet ti ni so ayeke mbeni.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s2.model.0: Weather ayeke so a mû permission, so la A, so asara ye na active permitting, ayeke nzoni ahon.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s2.model.1: Weather ayeke so a wara permission pëpe, so la B, so asara ye na -ed, ayeke sio.

l-e-h1-b06-07.title: "To whom" wala "To who"?
l-e-h1-b06-07.goal: Bâ ye 2 wala tënë 2 ti pronom relatif na pronom interrogatif na peko ti préposition, gbu ye so alingbi mingi, na fa ndali ti mo.
l-e-h1-b06-07.material: Na yâ ti sû ti formel, sara na ni ti "Who did you speak to?" A: To whom did you speak? B: To who did you speak?
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.o.a: A: Ayeke objet na peko ti préposition, ndali ni "whom"
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.o.b: B: "who" ayeke kete ti sara, ndali ni a lingbi mingi
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.r.b: Na yâ ti sû ti formel, sara na "whom" na peko ti préposition.

l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.r.d: A ayeke phrase ti formel so ayeke nzoni.
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.explain: Sara na "whom" ti objet na peko ti "to". Na yâ ti sû ti formel, "To whom" ayeke nzoni.
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s2.model.0: Ndo ti objet ti "to" a sara na "whom", ndali ni "To whom did you speak" ayeke nzoni.
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s2.model.1: Na peko ti préposition ayeke ndo ti objet, ndali ni B so a sara na "who" a lingbi na sû ti formel pëpe.

l-e-h1-b06-15.title: Mot ti bungbi wa tongana a yeke gï ti nzoni pëpe me mo na ngia?
l-e-h1-b06-15.goal: Bâ ye 2 wala tënë 2 ti "Nevertheless" na "Besides", gbu ye so alingbi mingi, na fa ndali ti mo.
l-e-h1-b06-15.material: The hike was long and hard. ___, we enjoyed it. "Nevertheless" wala "Besides" a lingbi ti ga na ndo so ayeke dä pëpe.
l-e-h1-b06-15.s.s1.o.a: "Besides": a bungbi information so a gue na ndo oko na ti kota na ti gï nzoni pëpe
l-e-h1-b06-15.s.s1.r.a: Ti tene so mo na ngia a gue na ndo ndeni na ti tene so a yeke gï nzoni pëpe.

l-e-h1-b06-15.s.s1.explain: Ti na ngia na mbeni randonnée so ayeke kota na gï nzoni pëpe ayeke ye so a kiri ni na ye so mo ye ni. "Nevertheless", so a fa contraste, ayeke nzoni.
l-e-h1-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: Ayeke ye so a si na ngbonga ni so ala na ngia atâa a yeke gï nzoni pëpe, ndali ni "Nevertheless", so a fa contraste, ayeke nzoni.
l-e-h1-b06-15.s.s2.model.1: "Besides" a bungbi information so a gue na ndo oko, ndali ni a lingbi na texte so pëpe, so ti gï nzoni pëpe na ngia a yeke na popo.

l-e-h1-b06-39.title: There being wala Being?
l-e-h1-b06-39.goal: Sara comparaison tî lege use wala claims use tî clause participiale so acommencer na there being, sï ôko so alingbi mingi, na fa raisonnement tî mo.
l-e-h1-b06-39.material: There were no seats, so we stood. A: There being no seats, we stood. B: Being no seats, we stood.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.o.a: A: Sujet so ayeke na sens, there, a bezoin ni kozo tî participe
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.o.b: B: Ni ayeke même na sujet tî clause principale, ndali ni a sû sujet ape
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.r.b: No seats ayeke ye nde na sujet tî clause principale we.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.r.c: Na B, sujet tî Being ayeke clair ape.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.r.d: A ayeke clause participiale so alingbi.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.explain: There tî There were no seats angbâ kozo tî participe, aga There being.... Ni ayeke nde na sujet tî clause principale we, ndali ni a sû ni nde.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s2.model.0: Sujet there tî clause participiale ayeke nde na sujet we tî clause principale, ndali ni alingbi tî a sû ni nde, tongana There being.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s2.model.1: Na B, sujet tî Being a lire ni tongana we, ndali ni ni alingbi tî afa so e ayeke sièges, so abâ bizarre.

l-e-h1-b07-07.title: The injured ayeke singulier wala pluriel?
l-e-h1-b07-07.goal: Kaï alege use wala atënë use ti nömörö ti verbe so ayeke na 'the + participe passé', sa choix ti oko so alingbi mingi, na fa raison.
l-e-h1-b07-07.material: The injured ___ taken to the hospital. A: injured ayeke adjectif, ni la a sara kua na verbe singulier was. B: the injured afa 'azo so ayeke blessés', ni la a sara kua na verbe pluriel were.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.o.a: A: Ni ayeke adjectif, ni la ni amû verbe singulier
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.r.a: the + participe afa mbeni ye oko ape, me 'azo so ~'.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.o.b: B: Ni afa 'azo blessés', ni la ni amû verbe pluriel
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.r.c: was na were alingbi ti ayeke tâ use na phrase oko ape.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.o.d: Use ayeke sio na injureds ayeke tâ
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.r.d: Zia -s na participe ape; sara kua na the injured tongana ni ayeke.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.explain: the + participe passé a sara kua na ni tongana pluriel, so afa 'azo so ~'. Ni la were ayeke tâ.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: the injured afa mingi azo blessés, ni la a lingbi ti sara kua na verbe pluriel were.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: Même tongana injured ayeke adjectif, tongana a sara kua na ni na the, ni afa azo, ni la B alingbi mingi.

l-e-h1-b05-40.material: Sales aya mingi tongana a sara comparaison na mois 5 (May). Conditions: ① Sara kua na phrase participiale ② Bata sens passif (a sara comparaison) ③ Sara kua na anzo 7 wala kêtê.
l-e-h1-b05-40.s.s1.r.a: Sales aga ye so asara comparaison, ndali ni ni aga actif.
l-e-h1-b05-40.s.s1.explain: Compared ayeke passif, tî ye so a sara comparaison na ni, na ayeke na anzo 7, ndali ni asatisfaire conditions ota kûê.
l-e-h1-b05-40.s.s2.model.0: Participe passé Compared abata sens passif na ayeke na anzo 7, ndali ni asatisfaire conditions ota kûê.
l-e-h1-b05-40.s.s2.model.1: Phrases nde ayeke actives, asara kua na forme tî base tî verbe, wala ayeke na anzo 8, ndali ni phrase so ayeke correct.

l-e-h1-b06-16.title: Ti change plan na "Instead"
l-e-h1-b06-16.goal: Na changement ti plan so a sara na Instead, bâ na bê ti mo condition kue so akpa tele ti ala, fa compromis so ayeke nzoni mingi, na fa ndali.
l-e-h1-b06-16.material: Ala lingbi ti hike pëpe ndali ti so ngû ayeke gä. Condition: ① Sara na Instead ② Tene so ala sara pain na place ti hike ③ Grammaire ayeke tâ.
l-e-h1-b06-16.s.s1.r.a: Ni asara na Besides, ayeke Instead pëpe.
l-e-h1-b06-16.s.s1.r.b: Instead of a hunda nom pekoni ti ni.

l-e-h1-b06-16.s.s2.model.1: Phrase ti nde ayeke na Instead pëpe, ayeke na grammaire sioni, wala asara contradiction, ni la phrase so ayeke tâ.
